blind.B1: Yes. Abstract: mice got bilateral e-stim (single session of eccentric/concentric contraction) or sham; RNA-seq of CD146+Lin- pericytes 3 h after contraction. In packet A the 3 'Stim' (S1-S3, grp STIM, treatment Exercised) samples carry the exercise factor; 3 'Unstim' (U1-U3) are sham. Only the abstract is available, no Methods.
blind.B2: e-stim vs sham, CD146+Lin- pericytes, 3 h post, 3 vs 3 male mice (GEO treatment_protocol, n=3/group). Abstract gives no other RNA-seq comparison.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: 6 samples, one per mouse, one cell type, one time point. No pairing key in packet A links any samples (0/6). Abstract mentions bilateral e-stim but each GSM is a sorted pericyte pool per animal.
blind.B4: Abstract does not say. GEO data_processing says gene counts were analyzed with the edgeR-quasi method; two groups only, so joint vs pairwise is moot.
blind.B5: Abstract gives no DEG rule or counts (only 'upregulation of genes related to immunomodulation and ECM remodeling'). Not stated in the available text.

checks.evidence: Series has an in vivo e-stim arm vs sham (abstract; packet A treatment Exercised/Not Exercised); analyzed.
grp STIM 3 / SHAM 3 from source_name_ch1 (S)/(U), identical to treatment column and to sample descriptions; alignment coverage 6/6, no exclusions; control = sham.
Contrast grp_STIM_vs_SHAM, control SHAM, treatment STIM; GSEA 'enriched in treatment' reads as STIM.
One sample per mouse, no repeated unit; repeated_measure_unit 'none'; no candidate keys link samples.
Single two-group model ~ grp; GEO says edgeR-quasi. DESeq2 run as sensitivity.
All male, same age/strain, same lane L002; no batch/housing column varies with group.

25% integer values, tximport lengthScaledTPM estimated counts; rounded and run through edgeR QL with TMM, declared as approximated. No low-expression filter was applied (edgeR tested 48759 genes vs DESeq2 20359), which dilutes BH power; the paper's filter is unknown.
checks.fix: Optional: add a filterByExpr-style filter as a sensitivity run.

checks.evidence: Paper rule not recoverable (abstract only); workflow default padj<0.05 and raw p audit recorded as default, not as the paper's (threshold_source workflow_default, deviation_note).
No paper counts available; paper_counts empty; HANDBACK states the comparison rests on the abstract and only compares direction. ECM caveat is stated honestly.

human_items: Paper threshold and DEG counts unverified: only the abstract was available; check against the full text if obtainable.
summary: 该系列为体内电刺激与假刺激各3只雄性小鼠的独立样本，分组、方向、模型和矩阵处理均与摘要及GEO记录一致，无重复测量或混杂。论文阈值和DEG数无法从摘要获得，已如实记为默认阈值并仅比较方向。仅有未做低表达过滤这一轻微问题。
